description: FL (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: The feed answers its whole current list in one response ('Заказы на FL.ru', RSS 2.0, the latest ~60 projects); query, category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent (the feed documents no parameters) — filter the returned postings client-side and ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). Titles/descriptions are Russian; the description is truncated by the feed ('…'); the category ('Раздел / Подраздел') is in raw.category; budgets are not in the feed.
